beaches.name: Psili Ammos, south of Vai
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix on the cove over the headland south of Vai. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2023 describing informal multilingual 'Nudist beach' signs on the path and a nude share that varies from a minority in August to a majority in September; a 2021 German directory entry and a Cretan beach guide also list it as nudist. Vai beach itself is not used for nude bathing; no authority designation is documented.

beaches.name: Itanos (Erimoupoli), southern cove
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in the southern cove at Itanos. The northern beaches are mostly clothed; a naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2002 to 2023, the latest describing an informal naturist sign at the entrance, and a 2021 German directory entry describes stones painted as FKK markers. A Cretan beach guide lists it as nudist-friendly; no authority designation is documented.

beaches.name: Alona (Krinakia / Katsounaki), Xerokampos
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix on the northernmost Xerokampos beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2012 to 2023; the August 2023 report found about ten nudists at the left end, facing the sea, among some fifty clothed bathers, while September reports from 2019 and 2020 found a nude majority. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Argilos and Gerontolakkos, Xerokampos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the clay-backed Argilos beach south of Xerokampos. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2018 to 2023 covering Argilos and the small Gerontolakkos cove; June 2018 and September 2019 found mostly nude bathers, while August 2023 found no nudity in high season. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Kouremenos bay north of Chiona, Palekastro
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on Palekastro bay just north of the Chiona hill. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2002 to 2018, the later ones noting few nudists and a cruising atmosphere; a 2026 listicle says the less accessible ends see informal naturist use. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Botzalaki, Goudouras
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the far end of the beach below the car park before Goudouras. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2010 and 2021; the 2021 report notes angry reactions from Greek families on a Sunday. No designation or signage is documented.
